title: A Royal Icing Christmas
description: A secret baking contest and an unexpected romance teach a duty-bound princess that love may be life's true crowning achievement.

title: A Christmas Prayer
description: Struggling with creative burnout, a children's book illustrator finds unexpected inspiration when she learns about a girl's Christmas wish for her recently widowed father to find happiness again.

title: 'Twas the Text Before Christmas
description: A text message mistakenly sent to Addie leads to a friendship with the sender, a Christmas tradition with the woman's family, and a budding romance with her son.

title: A Very Arctic Christmas
description: Stranded in an arctic town during Christmastime, a single father and his 20-year-old daughter meet a wildlife conservationist who helps them navigate the frozen wilderness.

title: Christmas Keepsake
description: Following their move to a new city, a father bonds with his daughter and stumbles upon an unexpected romance while tracking down the original owner of a Christmas time capsule.

title: A Paris Christmas Waltz
description: Emma encounters a professional dancer Leo, whose enthusiasm for competitive dancing is diminishing. However, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself for the novice to join the pro.

title: The Trouble With Christmas Mistletoe
description: An executive returns home for Christmas and reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

title: Jingle Bell Princess
description: After a series of mishaps, sophisticated Princess Amelia becomes stranded in the small town of Tucker Maine, where she becomes a guest of the unsuspecting Cutler family, widowed father Sam and daughter Sophie, but doesn't tell them she's a princess.

title: The Christmas Yes List
description: A chronic people-pleaser returns home for Christmas, determined to finally say yes to herself. An unexpected romance helps her discover that life's greatest gifts often come when you stop fearing the answer.

title: Three Generations, One Christmas
description: Three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey when a legendary song-and-dance man prepares to sell his beloved restaurant lounge.

title: Fir Crazy
description: A reluctant Christmas-tree seller (Sarah Lancaster) finds renewed holiday spirit and new romance with a repeat customer (Eric Johnson), but a mean-spirited executive (Colin Mochrie) threatens to shut down her family's business.

title: A Little Women's Christmas
description: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

title: A Vintage Christmas
description: A dedicated preservationist battles a developer's ambitions to tear down a historic Post Office with ties to her family. The choice of old versus new threatens to divide the small town unless there is a solution for the greater good of all concerned.

title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
description: A retired ballerina finds unexpected romance while working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to stage the holiday season's performance of "The Nutcracker.".

title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

title: Angel Falls Christmas
description: A devoted doctor with little time for the Christmas spirit is in desperate need of an intervention from the unlikeliest of places.

title: A Cinderella Christmas Ball
description: A dance instructor finds an old photo of a couple who may be her mother and father. Hoping to solve the mystery of her birth family, she travels to Havenshire where she meets a charming prince who dances with her at the Christmas ball.

title: Timeless Tidings of Joy
description: Ally, inherits Timeless Tidings, a shop her grandmother, Joy, opened in the 1940s to sell her handmade letter-press tidings. The shop was a labor of love, service, and sacrifice throughout the decades for Joy. Ally always saw Joy's sacrifices for the shop as a burden on Joy's life and happiness. When Ally returns to the shop to prepare it for sale, she meets Bennett, an old soul, who wants to preserve her Grandma Joy's legacy.

title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
description: A military widow meets an antiques dealer while searching for her family's long-lost heirloom ring. Their friendship promises to turn into a breathtaking romance, but shocking news hits right before Christmas.

title: Bringing Christmas Home
description: A professor of military history teams with an antique store owner to help track down the original owner of a historic World War II uniform and the love letters in its pockets.

title: Three Generations, One Christmas
description: Three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey when a legendary song-and-dance man prepares to sell his beloved restaurant lounge.
